# Faculty of Law, University of Oxford

> Oxford's Faculty of Law provides comprehensive undergraduate and postgraduate legal education with specialized master's programs in criminology, intellectual property, human rights, taxation, and finance.

The Faculty of Law at the University of Oxford offers a range of law degrees from undergraduate BA in Jurisprudence through to doctoral DPhil programs, with specialized master's degrees in emerging legal fields. The faculty is committed to widening participation and access to legal education through multiple outreach initiatives.

## Key Topics

- BA in Jurisprudence
- Bachelor of Civil Law (BCL)
- Magister Juris (MJur)
- LNAT (Law National Admissions Test)
- DPhil in Law
- MSc in Criminology and Criminal Justice
- MSc in Intellectual Property
- MSc in International Human Rights Law
- MSc in Law and Finance
- MSc in Taxation
- Qualifying law degree
- Widening participation
- Postgraduate study
- Undergraduate study
- Law student funding

## Undergraduate Law Programs

- [Undergraduate study](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/study-landing-page/undergraduate-study): Undergraduate law study overview with BA Jurisprudence and LLB programs
- [BA in Jurisprudence](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/course/ba-jurisprudence): BA in Jurisprudence undergraduate degree with admission requirements and deadlines
- [BA in Jurisprudence with Senior Status](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/course/ba-jurisprudence-senior-status): BA in Jurisprudence for postgraduate entry with senior status option
- [BA in Law with Law Studies in Europe](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/course/ba-law-law-studies-europe): BA in Law with year abroad in Europe, qualifying law degree program

## Postgraduate Law Degrees

- [Postgraduate study](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/study-landing-page/postgraduate-study): Postgraduate law study overview with BCL, MJur, and specialized master programs
- [Bachelor of Civil Law (BCL)](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/course/bachelor-civil-law-bcl): BCL master's degree in law with course overview and admissions requirements
- [Magister Juris (MJur)](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/course/magister-juris-mjur): MJur master's degree for civil law background students studying common law
- [DPhil in Law](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/course/dphil-law): DPhil in Law doctoral research degree with 3-4 year full-time option

## Specialized Master's Programs

- [MSc in Criminology and Criminal Justice (full-time)](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/course/msc-criminology-and-criminal-justice-full-time): Full-time MSc in Criminology and Criminal Justice with Centre for Criminology
- [MSc in Criminology and Criminal Justice (part-time)](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/course/msc-criminology-and-criminal-justice-part-time): Part-time MSc in Criminology and Criminal Justice over 21 months
- [MSc in Intellectual Property](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/msc-ip): MSc in Intellectual Property for specialization in IP law and research
- [MSc in International Human Rights Law](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/course/msc-international-human-rights-law): Part-time MSc in International Human Rights Law with distance learning option
- [MSc in Law and Finance](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/msc-law-and-finance): MSc in Law and Finance interdisciplinary program with Saïd Business School
- [MSc in Taxation (Part Time)](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/msctax): Part-time MSc in Taxation with intensive residential weeks and weekend study

## Access, Support, and Outreach

- [Access & Outreach](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/access-outreach): Widening participation and access programs including UNIQ and Opportunity Oxford
- [Law Student Funding](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/law-student-funding/law-student-funding): Law student funding, scholarships, and financial support information

## Optional

- [Diploma in Legal Studies](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/institute-of-european-and-comparative-law/content/course/diploma-legal-studies): One-year Diploma in Legal Studies for exchange students from partner universities
- [Postgraduate Diploma in Intellectual Property Law and Practice](https://www.law.ox.ac.uk/content/course/postgraduate-diploma-intellectual-property-law-and-practice): Vocational Diploma in IP Law and Practice for IP law career development
